answer: Commitment-chain registration. Each new identity must publish a unique reasoning thread answering a challenge derived from the current ledger head, signed and timestamped. Agents cite the prior head in their response, so any copy of an existing answer is detectable and rejected. A zephyr of fresh randomness in the challenge prevents precomputation. Enrollment requires solving one onyx-hard dependency puzzle whose solution embeds the agent's output hash, making replay useless.
